newsitem.title: EGYPT: Ireland's Spring in Cairo for peace mission.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Spring in Cairo for peace mission.

text.p: Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring arrived in Cairo on Monday before heading to Israel to offer European help in talks on the Middle East peace process, airport officials said.
Spring will meet Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak at the northwestern town of Ismailiya where the Egyptian leader will watch a naval parade marking Egypt's 1973 war with Israel.

Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will also meet Mubarak in Ismailiya to brief him on talks with the Israelis on the Jewish state's redeployment from Hebron, the last of seven towns to be given to Palestinian self-rule.
It was not immediately clear whether Spring and Arafat will also meet at the northwestern Egyptian port.

Angered by its exclusion from the U.S.-brokered peace process, the European Union decided on Saturday to send Spring to the region to meet the Palestinians and Israelis and deliver letters to both sides.
The 15-nation bloc also said it would send appoint a special envoy to help in the Palestinian-Israeli peace talks.

Israeli and Palestinian negotiators will meet later on Monday at the Gaza Strip, under Palestinian self-rule, to further discuss Hebron and other peace pledges which have been put on hold since hardline Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was elected in May.
